text: Cycling is a popular sport and efficient mode of transport enjoyed by people of all ages and fitness levels. It involves riding a bicycle at a steady speed on a closed course, typically on a road or a track. One of the most critical components of cycling is the brakes, which are used to slow or stop the bicycle. Properly functioning brakes are essential for controlling speed and preventing accidents, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience. Additionally, cyclists often opt for specific tires designed for their particular riding conditions, such as road or mountain tires, which provide varying levels of puncture resistance and rolling resistance. The choice between these tire types depends on the cyclist’s intended use and the terrain they will be cycling on.
